mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypocalcemia and electrolyte depletion (calcium, magnesium, potassium) impairs alendronate efficacy and increases risk of adverse effects including osteonecrosis of jaw and atypical fractures.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, potassium) regularly; ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D supplementation; consider alternative diuretic or optimize loop diuretic dosing; counsel on proper alendronate administration technique.
